name: totr-spa-apk
description: TOTR listener app: the Android shell (Capacitor). The APK holds only the launcher in android-launcher/ and the native audio/update/offline code in android/; it opens the server's own copy of the app.
author: the TOTR authors

scripts.sync: npm run sync-ca && cap sync android
scripts.build: npm run sync && cd android && sh gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && node tools/release-apk.cjs
scripts.build:windows: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease && cd .. && node tools/release-apk.cjs
